description: Navigate to a URL or launch/focus a configured Electron app.

app.description: Electron app name configured in config.json under 'electron' (e.g. 'example' or 'my-dev-app'). When specified, targets or launches the Electron app.

force.description: If true, overwrites current tab even if it's protected (anchor tab). Otherwise opens a new tab automatically.

tab_id.description: Target a specific tab ID for navigation instead of the active tab.

url.description: Absolute URL to navigate to (must include https:// or app URL). Optional if 'app' is specified.

name: browser_navigate
